SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN customer_demographics ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1999
JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND s_state IN ('TN','TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_id 
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
